decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the boundary treatments of the hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - No development of the rear extension shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the rear extension hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unnumbered Location Plan, ND-1804-PL-EX24, ND-1804-PL-EX23, ND-1804-PL-EX22, ND-1804-PL-GA23, ND-1804-PL-EX200, ND-1804-PL-EX100, Unnumbered Block Plan, Design and Access Statement - Received 04/12/2018. ND-1804-PL-GA21 Rev A, ND-1804-PL-GA03 Rev B, ND-1804-PL-GA04 Rev B, ND-1804-PL-GA22 Rev A, ND-1804-PL-GA02 Rev B, ND-1804-PL-GA01 Rev B, ND-1804-PL-GA24 Rev B, ND-1804-PL-EX01 Rev A, ND-1804-PL-EX02 Rev A, ND-1804-PL-EX03 Rev A - Received 31/01/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.

Condition : 7 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 9 - Prior to the commencement of works to the vehicular access, details shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, in regards to the area of hardstanding that addresses surface water run-off. Either a porous material shall be proposed or provisions made to direct run-off water from the hard surface to a permeable or porous area or surface within the curtilage of the dwellinghouse. Work shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, insertion of one front and one rear roof windows to existing roof, creation of a vehicular access to the house
